question: Bosch Limited (NSE: BOSCHLTD) ne apni nayi commissioned facilities ke baare mein sabse latest kya kaha hai? Deck, concall aur annual report teeno check karke source do.
answer: Bosch Limited ka sabse latest (FY25 annual report, 8 Jul 2025, known 2025-07-08) statement ke mutabik, nayi/commissioned facilities ka mention ye hai: Phase 2 group captive solar initiative ka commissioning hua jisse campus ki ~75% energy needs green energy se meet hote hain; Adugodi South Campus R&D lab infrastructure upgrade; relocated manufacturing (Bengaluru to Bidadi) ke baad vacated hangar ko BGSW lab mein convert kiya ja raha hai, expected operational 2HY2025; ChiP (Chennai Power Tools) relocated from rented premises to Bosch-owned premises; GanP (Gangaikondan) 10th anniversary celebrations. Source: FY25 Annual Report p58-60, p174. Deck/concall mein nahi mila (not in data).
working: FY25 annual report (known 2025-07-08) chunk 63454 (p60) and 63547 (p174) mention Phase 2 solar commissioning, BGSW lab conversion (2HY2025), ChiP relocation, campus upgrades. No deck/concall row returned for this query.
missing: Deck aur concall mein "newly commissioned facilities" ka explicit mention not in data; latest source FY25 annual report hi hai.

rows.body_excerpt: ANNUAL REPORT 2025-26 32 CoolPack Technology Bosch’s CoolPack technology is an advanced thermal management system designed to enhance the performance and longevity of lithium-ion batteries used in their professional power tools. By efficiently dissipating heat, Cool Pack ensures that batteries remain cooler during operation, which is crucial for maintaining optimal performance and extending battery life. Tabless Technology Bosch’s new tabless battery technology in the ProCORE18V+ reduces internal resistance by 50 percent, enabling faster energy flow and lower heat generation. This results in up to 71 percent longer runtime and extended battery life, even under heavy loads. Paired with COOLPACK 2.0, it delivers top-tier cordless performance in a compact form.
